codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes, Ordinance Requirements
findings.comment: Note stating 'All improvements shall be made in accordance with the released site plan. Any additional improvements will require a site plan amendment and approval from the Development Services Department' is missing from the cover sheet. While this note appears on Sheet 9, it is required on the cover sheet per the General Site Plan Notes template.

Floor Area Ratio (FAR) calculations are not provided on the cover sheet. Whether FAR limits apply to MF-2 zoning cannot be verified from the available documents; LDC provisions for the zoning district must be confirmed to determine applicability.

Notation conventions (defining line types, symbols, and hatch patterns) are not specified on the cover sheet. Without notation conventions established on the cover sheet, consistency across all construction documents cannot be verified or enforced.

Case number SP-2025-0126C is not displayed on all sheets of the plan set. Master Comment Report (CM 8) confirms 'There are several sheets that the site plan number does not appear as required.' Verification of Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) confirmed absence of case number. Case number must appear on cover sheet, site plan sheets, landscape sheets, elevation sheets, architectural sheets, and all supplemental sheets.

Case number is not displayed in the lower right corner or lower right margin on all sheets. Master Comment Report (CM 8) documents this deficiency; landscape plan sheets in particular are missing the case number from the lower right margin where required.
Cover sheet does not include a Related Cases section. This section is required by UCM 2.5.1(E) to list all applicable case numbers, legal documents, and administrative items affecting the site.

Related Cases section does not list applicable zoning case numbers. Zoning Case No. C14-2011-0093 (per Site Development Data on cover sheet) must be included in the Related Cases section once created.

Related Cases section does not list prior site plan approval case numbers. Prior site plan SP-97-0145CS (Southwood Nursing Care Center Addition, approved 1997) must be documented in the Related Cases section once created.

Engineer's report (Engineer's Summary Letter) does not include the correct case number SP-2025-0126C. The letter header identifies the project as 'Valley View Townhomes' and references the address but omits the site plan case number. Case number must be clearly cited in the engineer's report for administrative tracking and cross-reference.
